transposable_ue.note: Agentforce is available in the EU. An agent that captures and qualifies leads requires a clear GDPR legal basis for processing prospect data and, under the AI Act, a transparency obligation: telling the visitor they are talking to an AI. The conversational SDR pattern transposes, but data compliance and grounding on approved content have to be redone.

pattern: genAI SDR agent for lead engagement and qualification
objectif_business: Engage high-intent prospects 24/7 from the moment they request information on the site, qualify the right leads, and offload appointment booking, to free membership advisors for high-value interactions during demand peaks.
points_cles: Quin, an Agentforce SDR agent, engages Equinox prospects over chat and email, qualifies leads, and books club visits.
Built on Agentforce Sales and Data 360, grounded on Equinox site content, launched ahead of the December 2025 holidays.
48% of prospects handed to an advisor become members, 7,300+ leads engaged, response time down from 48 hours to 17 seconds.
Level B evidence: two consistent Salesforce case studies, live status confirmed.

resultats.metrique: Prospects handed to an advisor who become members
Open rate of Quin's emails (about 3x the industry average)
Leads autonomously developed by Quin (New York clubs, 5+ months)

niveau_preuve.justification: Two Salesforce case studies (vendor, T2) published in August 2026 and consistent with each other: one focused on lead engagement (Quin as SDR), the other on building the agent, with the same figures (48%, 60%, 7,300+) and the 48 hours to 17 seconds response time. The metrics measure the AI deployment itself, not a general company context.

stack_technique.detail: Quin is built on Agentforce Sales from the ready-made Agentforce Lead Nurturing template, then configured to the Equinox brand voice. Low code: natural language plus a bit of Apex.
Grounds Quin's answers in approved Equinox content, pulled from the Equinox.com sitemap (clubs, equipment, policies, memberships).
Syncs emails and calendar between Agentforce Sales and Microsoft Outlook, giving advisors visibility into the conversations and visits scheduled by Quin.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time, 24/7, from the moment information is requested on the site; email follow-ups spread over several days per prospect.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Equinox product and marketing teams, with support from Salesforce teams for scoping and governance.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The intent expressed by the prospect in their request, plus the lead's state in Agentforce Sales (engaged, waiting, missed appointment). Without up-to-date Equinox content in Data 360 and up-to-date advisor availability in Outlook, the answers and bookings lose their reliability.

etapes.detail: The prospect opens a conversation with Quin from the Equinox site and asks about membership, equipment, clubs.
Quin analyzes the intent, retrieves the answer via Data 360 (Equinox.com sitemap content), and replies over chat or email; the request is captured as a lead in Agentforce Sales.
On a visit request, Quin recommends a nearby club via Google Maps and reads advisors' real availability via Outlook to schedule the visit.
As soon as an advisor engages, Quin steps back to avoid double contact; it re-engages if the conversation stalls or an appointment is missed.
The team tracks engaged leads, the conversion rate into membership, and mishandled cases through the test frameworks set up at launch.

prerequis_data: Up-to-date reference content (offers, clubs, policies) exposable to the agent in read mode
A history of frequent prospect questions to frame the scope
Access to sales reps' calendars for appointment booking
prerequis_orga: A clear handoff rule between the agent and the human sales rep
A test framework validated before exposure to real prospects
stack_possible: A conversational agent platform connected to the CRM
A grounding layer on site content (RAG)
A calendar and mapping connector for appointment booking
replication.premiere_etape: List the 15 to 20 most frequent prospect questions and connect a read-only agent to the site content before opening up appointment booking.

playbook.action: Map recurring prospect questions from sales conversations and inbound requests.
playbook.livrable: A repository of questions and approved answers.

playbook.action: Configure an agent on the CRM platform from a lead nurturing template, grounded on site content in read mode.
playbook.livrable: Agent that answers frequent questions in the brand voice.

playbook.action: Define the handoff rule: when the agent steps back for the sales rep, when it re-engages.
playbook.livrable: Handoff logic tested on real cases.

playbook.action: Connect the calendar and mapping for appointment booking, then open up to a prospect segment with conversion tracking.
playbook.livrable: Autonomous appointment booking and tracked conversion rate.

replication.equipe: A product and marketing team (product manager, sales ops) with a profile to administer the CRM platform and the agent layer.

statut_vivant.note: Salesforce case studies dated August 11, 2026. A multi-agent exploration around Quin started in the summer of 2026, a sign of extension rather than withdrawal.
